assumptions: Every batch holds the same cell populations in similar proportions; a population found in one batch only is pulled toward the others.
Within one map node a batch effect is a shift and a scaling of each channel, as ComBat models it.
limits: The corrected files are written to the project from the panel only; this door returns the node summary and the medians.
No covariates or anchors, no non-parametric ComBat and no other clustering than the kohonen map.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where must each cell move so that the batches agree within every group of similar cells, without a control sample?

description: cyCombine batch correction without controls: every value on asinh(x / cofactor) (counts rounded up first), each batch scaled on its own, a kohonen self-organizing map grouping the scaled cells, then parametric ComBat inside each map node on the unscaled values with batch as the only factor (optionally onto one reference batch), each result capped to the node's range and taken back by sinh.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_cofactor.description: the asinh cofactor (5 for mass cytometry).

batch_column.description: the sample sheet's column naming each file's batch.

channels.description: the channels to correct, comma-separated PnN; empty for every channel but scatter, time and event length.

derand.description: round counts up (ceiling) before the transform.

epochs.description: kohonen rlen: passes over the data.

ref_batch.description: ComBat ref.batch: a batch left as it is, the others moved onto it; empty for none.

sample_sheet.description: a CSV in the project whose first column, headed sample, names each FCS file, with a batch column.

samples.description: the FCS files, by name or id, comma-separated; empty for every FCS file in the project (each must be named in the sample sheet).

name: correct_flow_cytometry_batches_cycombine

medians.description: per channel and batch, the median before and after (asinh scale)

nodes.description: per map node, the cells per batch and whether ComBat corrected it (location and scale, location only, or left as it is)
